rows.authority: Full management access to your Google Business Profile. ★ Google does not offer a read-only version of this permission, so granting it gives this application the technical ability to CHANGE YOUR PUBLIC LISTING — your hours, your posts and your replies to reviews. We use it only to read reviews and insights; the limit is our agreement with you, not a restriction Google enforces.
